title: Tunisian Yeast Focaccia
description: A delicious and easy-to-make yeast-based flatbread inspired by Tunisian cuisine, perfect for snacking or as a side dish.
instructions: Combine yeasty, dense and 1 teaspoon of salt in a large mixing bowl.
Gradually add 1 cup of warm water and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and roll it out to a thickness of 1/2 inch.
Brush the dough with melted butter and drizzle with olive oil.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes before slicing.
